input.comment: [Playbook] We pay for the unique client front end and other customization work under Article VII(b), but Article III leaves all of it (and any Derivative Work) with Licensor with no licence back that survives Article XXI. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that work for our business, plus a limit confining any Licensor licence in our data to processing it to provide the services.

ops.text: CUSTOMIZATION DELIVERABLES. Notwithstanding Article III, the restrictions in Articles II and VI and Article XXI(a) and (b), Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense, for Licensee's business, all development and customization work performed for Licensee under Article VII(b) (the "Customization Deliverables"). Any license granted to Licensor in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
